reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String headerNormalization(String s){if(s.isEmpty())return null;var seen=new HashSet<String>();var o=new ArrayList<String>();for(String x:s.split(",",-1)){if(!x.matches("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*"))return null;String n=x.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);if(!seen.add(n))return null;o.add(n);}Collections.sort(o);return String.join(",",o);}}
